    Corollaries 1.1 and 5.6 #

    Applying the representation embedding of Theorem 5.2 to Kronecker bricks of every infinite dimension gives indecomposable modules of every infinite dimension, with local endomorphism algebras whose radicals are nilpotent of an exponent independent of the dimension (Corollary 5.7, through the retractions on C of Theorem 5.2).

    The Kronecker bricks are supplied by Göbel–Simson, Corollary 1.3; here this input is the hypothesis KroneckerBricks.
